name: Supplier Social Assessment
purpose: GRI 414: Supplier Social Assessment 2016 contains disclosures for organizations to report information about their social impacts in their supply chain, and how they manage these impacts. The disclosures enable an organization to provide information on its approach to preventing and mitigating negative social impacts in its supply chain. The Standard is structured as follows: • Section 1 contains a requirement, which provides information about how the organization manages its social impacts in it
